_comment: Desired state for the Supagen workspace. The `setup` skill reads this and creates anything missing VIA MCP. Resolve model_slug -> model_id with list_models at setup time; the id hints here may go stale.
_architecture: ONE generation template, MANY versions -- one per model. Switching model is activate_version, not a per-call argument. This was tested: the REST /api/v1/invoke endpoint SILENTLY IGNORES version_number (a request for version 99, which does not exist, ran the active version instead), while the MCP invoke_template tool honours it. Since generation must go over curl (rule 2), the active version is what runs. Treat activate_version as the model switch and keep pipeline.json's `model` field in step with it.

templates.name: video-watching-layer
templates.description: Stage 2 watching layer. Takes a trimmed reference segment and returns the six-section scene report: verbatim transcript, delivery, shot list, physical details, audio, on-screen text.

versions.name: v1-gemini-3-8-flash
versions._model_note: Measured against Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview on byte-identical instructions: 5x cheaper, faster, more detailed, and it does not misreport burned-in captions as speech -- 3.1 Pro did, consistently. Do not downgrade.

templates.name: ugc-recreation
templates.description: Stage 6 generation. One template, one version per model. The ACTIVE version is the model that runs. Every version is messages-only -- no system_instructions, no variables -- so the prompt is sent exactly once and its quotes are not HTML-escaped.
templates._version_rules: Every version here MUST keep system_instructions unset, variables empty, duration null, and the integer duration inside extensions. Those four together are AGENTS.md rules 4 and 6.

versions.name: v1-minimax-h3-max-15s-9x16
versions._model_note: DEFAULT. $0.04/s -- by far the cheapest that does the job, and a full 15s run costs $0.60 against $2.80 for 20s of Wan. Caps at 15s and 768p. Tuned for prompt adherence, which is what this pipeline leans on hardest.
versions._resolution_note: resolution lives in extensions as '768P', NOT in top-level video_settings. Supagen lowercases the top-level field and fal rejects '768p' with "Input should be '480P' or '768P'". Verified against a working invocation. Same class of bug as duration.

versions.name: v2-wan-3-prime-20s-9x16
versions._model_note: Use when you need longer than 15s -- it is the only option that reaches 30s. $0.14/s, so 20s is $2.80. 720p.

versions.name: v3-gemini-omni-1-1-10s-9x16
versions._model_note: Best quality per second measured so far -- word-perfect dialogue, flatter green screen (within-frame G std 12.3 vs Wan's 14.6), genuine over-the-shoulder framing. Capped at 10s, so only for short pieces. $0.10/s.

templates.name: ugc-continuation
templates.description: Continuation generator. Image-to-video seeded with the last frame of the previous segment, so a piece can exceed the per-model duration cap. Create it only when the target runtime is longer than the chosen model's cap.
templates._seed_frame_status: UNVERIFIED MECHANISM. video_settings.source_image is IGNORED at invoke level -- tested with a deliberately bogus image URL, which generated anyway instead of failing. The documented alternative is a message content part {"type":"image","source":{"file_id":...}} alongside the prompt text, which is what extend.sh sends, but that has NOT been confirmed to reach the model. Verify with one cheap generation before relying on this.

versions.name: v1-minimax-h3-max-i2v-15s-9x16
versions._model_note: $0.04/s, 15s cap, 768p. Pair with the MiniMax generation version.

versions.name: v2-wan-3-prime-i2v-20s-9x16
versions._model_note: $0.28/s -- DOUBLE the text-to-video price. A 20s continuation is $5.60. Reaches 30s.

versions.name: v3-gemini-omni-1-1-i2v-10s-9x16
versions._model_note: $0.10/s, 10s cap. Also supports an end frame, so two seeds can bracket a segment.

known_model_limits._comment: Measured against the provider, not taken from marketing copy. generate.sh reads this to reject an impossible request before it costs anything, and to compute cost from list price x seconds.

unsupported._comment: Looks available, is not. Do not spend time rediscovering these.
unsupported.gemini-omni-flash-1-1-reference-to-video: Unreachable through Supagen. The adapter builds a fixed payload (aspect_ratio, duration, generate_audio, num_videos, prompt, resolution) and silently drops references sent as message parts, reference_images, source_video, or any extensions key; type:image is explicitly rejected. The fal endpoint requires image_url or reference_video_url, so the model cannot be invoked at all.

provider_quirks._comment: Field-level traps. Each cost a round trip or a wasted generation.
provider_quirks.duration: Never set video_settings.duration to an integer -- every fal model serialises it as "20s" and rejects its own string. Set it null and put the integer in extensions.duration.
provider_quirks.minimax_resolution: Put resolution in extensions as '768P' (uppercase). Supagen lowercases the top-level video_settings.resolution and fal rejects '768p'.
provider_quirks.version_number: The REST /api/v1/invoke endpoint silently ignores version_number and runs the ACTIVE version. Only the MCP tool honours it. Switch models with activate_version.
provider_quirks.source_image: Ignored at invoke level -- a bogus URL generated anyway instead of erroring. UNVERIFIED whether a message image content part works; test before relying on it.
